uncertain: The supplied label 'Butia capitata (Cocos australis)' contains a taxonomic conflict: Kew accepts Cocos australis as a synonym of Syagrus romanzoffiana, not Butia capitata
Kew accepts true Butia capitata as a Brazilian species and lists Cocos capitata as its historical synonym

Many older horticultural plants sold as Butia capitata belong to the broader former concept that included Butia odorata; without the individual plant or provenance, true Butia capitata versus B. odorata cannot be confirmed
RHS retains a horticultural Butia capitata profile with broader historical distribution and H3 hardiness, so its UK cultivation data were used while the identity conflict is retained here
